title: Lambda-quantiles under the microscope
abstract: arXiv:2608.07122v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study Lambda-quantiles, a generalisation of classical quantiles in which the constant probability level $\lambda \in [0,1]$ is replaced by a functional parameter $\Lambda \colon \mathbb{R} \to [0,1]$. We consider the general case of non-monotone $\Lambda$, which arises naturally if closure properties of the class of corresponding Lambda-quantiles with respect to inf-aggregation or with respect to mixtures are required. As preliminary results, we characterise finiteness, constancy, and what we call the attainment property known from classical quantiles. We then consider the problem of reconstructing $\Lambda$ from the values of $\Lambda$-quantiles on a suitable family of simple distributions, showing its identifiability under mild assumptions. translated_abstract: 我们研究Lambda分位数，它是经典分位数的一种推广，其中恒定的概率水平 $\lambda \in [0,1]$ 被替换为一个函数型参数 $\Lambda \colon \mathbb{R} \to [0,1]$。我们考虑非单调 $\Lambda$ 的一般情形，当要求相应的Lambda分位数类在下确界聚合或混合运算下具有封闭性时，这种情形会自然出现。作为初步结果，我们刻画了有限性、常数性以及经典分位数中所熟知的可达性质。随后，我们考虑从一族适当的简单分布上的Lambda分位数值重构 $\Lambda$ 的问题，并在温和假设下证明了其可识别性。接着，我们大幅精炼了文献中关于弱上半连续性与弱下半连续性，以及水平集在混合下凸性等方面的若干已有结果。
tldr: 该论文系统研究了将经典分位数中恒定概率水平λ推广为函数型参数Λ的Lambda分位数，在非单调情形下刻画了其有限性、常数性与可达性等基本性质，并证明了在温和假设下Λ可由简单分布族上的分位数值唯一识别。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies Lambda-quantiles, which generalize classical quantiles by replacing the constant probability level λ with a functional parameter Λ, characterizing their finiteness, constancy, and attainment properties in the non-monotone case, and proving the identifiability of Λ from quantile values on simple distributions under mild assumptions.
